producer_report.summary: Added safeguard_trial.rs with a pure `judge` function. It refuses an empty defect set, an empty name, a zero baseline cost, or a zero catch or cost limit. Otherwise it rejects, in order, a low catch rate, too many regressions, or overhead over the limit. If none of those apply it returns Accepted. It is declared in lib.rs, recorded as OLY-9-06's mechanism and measure (`status: not shown`) in docs/spec.toml, and logged in CHANGELOG.md.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml OLY-9-06 has mechanism naming crates/athena-core/src/safeguard_trial.rs (not "none"), keeps owner Apollo, and a measure ending in `status: not shown` that names `cargo test -p athena-core safeguard_trial`.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited docs/spec.toml OLY-9-06: mechanism names the file, owner Apollo, measure 'cargo test -p athena-core safeguard_trial; status: not shown'.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/safeguard_trial.rs exists and is declared with `pub mod safeguard_trial;` in crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs; the module doc states the requirement it serves.
criteria_check.evidence: File created; lib.rs has pub mod safeguard_trial; module doc says 'Serves requirement OLY-9-06'.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core safeguard_trial`: tests show a safeguard that catches enough similar defects within the regression and overhead limits is Accepted; one that misses similar defects, one that causes regressions above the limit, and one whose overhead exceeds the limit are each Rejected with a distinct reason; empty defect set or a missing/zero limit is refused rather than accepted (no empty success). Each rejection test would fail if the corresponding check were removed.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran the command: 7 tests pass (accept, exact-limit accept, three distinct rejections, empty set refusal, missing name/baseline/limit refusals). Each rejection test hits only its own check, so removing that check yields Accepted and fails the test.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test`: all pass.
CHANGELOG.md gains an entry for safeguard_trial.rs in the style of the method_experiment.rs entry.
criteria_check.evidence: Added entry at the top of Unreleased/Added mirroring the method_experiment entry.

learnings: Bash hook allows only cargo, chmod, git, ls, mv and rm; pipes to tail or grep are refused.
CHANGELOG.md has many '### Added' headings, so an edit needs surrounding context to be unique.
